section_summary.extract_value: This section defines self-leadership as a 3-factor self-regulatory mechanism (behavior focused, natural reward, and thought pattern strategies) and elaborates on each. It reviews existing literature on self-leadership's predictors and outcomes, including its relationship with learning orientation, personality traits, self-efficacy, task performance, creativity, and work role innovation. The section concludes by presenting several hypotheses (Hypotheses 2.1-2.4 and 3.1-3.4) regarding the mediating and moderating roles of self-leadership strategies in the relationships between learning/performance orientation and proactive/adaptive work role performance.
